mapper.select: select c.*, s.store_name, r.room_name, r.type roomType, from member_clear_info c left join member_store_info s on c.store_id = s.store_id left join member_room_info r ON r.room_id = c.room_id left join member_store_user su ON su.store_id = c.store_id and su.user_id = c.user_id where c.clear_id = #{clearId}

select count(1) from member_clear_info where deleted = 0 and user_id = #{userId} and status = #{status}
and to_days(create_time)=to_days(#{dateStr}) and DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m')=DATE_FORMAT(#{dateStr}, '%Y-%m')
